==Description==
'''Spooky''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that can be obtained from reaching Rank 6 on the [[Lunar Overture Event#Lunar Overture Season Pass|Lunar Overture Season]]. Alternatively, it can be purchased for {{Coins|1,250}} in the emote store. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote. You can move while performing this emote.

This emote was obtainable at Rank 6 on the [[Lunar Overture Event#Lunar Overture Season Pass|Lunar Overture Season]], which had a cost of {{Pumpkins|1,300 Pumpkins}} or {{Robux|180}} at that rank. The total cost to buy all ranks was {{Robux|820}}. On the 31st of October 2023, it was removed from the season pass, though it was re-added later the same day.

==Trivia==
*The emote is a reference to the SrPelo dance from the ''Spooky Month'' series.
